Hindu Calendar Events and Astrological Predictions for Late June 2026

Multiple Hindu calendar events, including Shani Pradosh Vrat, Jyeshtha Purnima, and Shani Trayodashi, are scheduled for late June 2026. Shani Pradosh Vrat and Shani Trayodashi are observed on June 27, 2026, with specific rituals for worshipping Shiva and Shani Dev. Jyeshtha Purnima, which includes a Bhadra period, is set for June 29, 2026, with guidelines for bathing and donations. Astrological predictions for June 27, 2026, suggest financial benefits for some zodiac signs and the formation of a Navpancham Rajyog on Shani Trayodashi.
